records.context: Tavern commands, their Help links, and the connection between buying a round and recruiting.
records.source_Japanese:
街のコマンド
街で実行できるコマンドです。建物の看板を選ぶと実行できます。
（都市のみ）と表示されているコマンドは街の規模が「[[145|都市]]」の場合のみ実行できます。
→[[12|酒場]]　→[[21|交易所]]　→[[26|ギルド]]　→[[34|宿屋]]
→[[35|王宮・総督府]]　→[[42|広場]]　→[[44|造船所]]　→[[73|出港所]]→[[144|街データ]]　→[[103|街／洋上共通のコマンド]]
【！】街の[[80|遺跡]]などに行けることもあります。
records.source_meaning: Choose a building sign to run its town command. City-only commands require a City. The original list includes other town functions and ruins.
records.previous_English:
Town Commands 
Select a building's sign to use its 
commands. Commands marked 'City only' are 
available only in a [[145|City.]] See[[12| Tavern,]]
[[21|Market,]][[26| Guild,]][[34| Inn,]]
[[35|Palace or Governor's Office,]][[42| Square,]]
[[44|Shipyard,]][[73| Port,]][[144| City Info]] and
[[103|Shared Commands.]] [!] You may also be able 
to visit local[[80| ruins.]]
records.english: Town Commands Select a building's sign to use its commands. Commands marked 'City only' are available only in a [[145|City.]] See[[12| Tavern,]] [[21|Market,]][[26| Guild,]][[34| Inn,]] [[35|Palace or Governor's Office,]][[42| Square,]] [[44|Shipyard,]][[73| Port,]][[144| City Info]] and [[103|Shared Commands.]] [!] You may also be able to visit local[[80| ruins.]]
records.localization_note: The parent Help page identifies the Tavern with the correct link and retains the City-only rule.

records.source_Japanese:
酒場
水夫の募集、情報収集などを行います。
【！】アラブ文化圏は宗教上の理由から酒場のない街が多く、水夫を集めにくいので、うかつに戦闘を仕掛けるのは危険です。
→[[13|飲み物をたのむ]]　→[[14|みんなにおごる]]
→[[15|水夫を集める]]　→[[16|策謀の立案]]
records.source_meaning: Recruit and gather information at the Tavern. Religious restrictions leave many towns in Arab cultural regions without one, so replacing sailors is harder and starting fights is risky.
records.previous_English:
Tavern
Recruit crew and gather news at the 
Tavern. Many towns in 
Arab cultural regions have no tavern for
religious reasons. It's harder to find
sailors there, so think twice before
starting a battle. See[[13| Order Drink,]]
[[14|Treat Everyone,]][[15| Recruit Crew,]] and
[[16|Schemes.]]
records.heading: Tavern

records.localization_note: Match the Tavern command in the index and retain the four links, religious context and warning about replacing sailors.

records.source_Japanese:
飲み物をたのむ（酒場）
飲み物をたのみます。金貨５～10枚が必要です。近辺にある街の情報や、他勢力の情報を聞けることがあります。
【！】[[145|都市]]の酒場には、話相手をしてくれる女性がいます。情報通の彼女たちとは、積極的に話をしてみましょう。アイテムのありかが分かることも…。
records.source_meaning: Order a drink for five to ten gold. Learn about nearby towns or other factions. Knowledgeable women in city taverns may know where an item is hidden.
records.previous_English:
Order Drink (Tavern)
A drink costs 5 to 10 gold coins. You may 
hear news about nearby towns or other 
factions. [!] Talk with the well-informed 
women at taverns in [[145|Cities.]] They may even
know where to find an item.
records.english: Order Drink (Tavern) A drink costs 5 to 10 gold coins. You may hear news about nearby towns or other factions. [!] Talk with the well-informed women at taverns in [[145|Cities.]] They may even know where to find an item.
records.localization_note: The article distinguishes a single drink from buying drinks for the room and keeps the price and the item clue.

records.source_Japanese:
みんなにおごる（酒場）
酒場で飲む人々に飲み物をおごります。
近くの街の情報や、他勢力の情報を聞けます。水夫を集める前に実行すると、水夫が集まりやすくなります。
また、アイテムの情報を教えてくれる
ことも…。
→[[15|水夫を集める]]
records.source_meaning: Buy drinks for the people at the Tavern. Learn about towns or factions and sometimes items. Buying drinks before recruiting improves turnout.
records.previous_English:
Treat Everyone (Tavern) 
Buy a round for everyone in the Tavern. 
You'll hear news about nearby towns and 
other factions, and you may get a tip 
about an item. Buying a round before you
choose[[15| Recruit Crew]] makes it easier to 
find sailors.
records.heading: Buy a Round (Tavern)
records.english: Buy a round for everyone in the Tavern. You'll hear news about nearby towns and other factions, and you may get a tip about an item. Buy a round before choosing [[15|Recruit Crew]] to improve turnout.
records.localization_note: Use the same caption as the menu. The explanation preserves the room, kinds of information and recruiting benefit with a shorter final instruction.

records.source_Japanese:
水夫を集める（酒場）
船に乗せる水夫を募集します。
街の発展度が高いほど一度に多く集まりますが、金貨がたくさん必要です。必要以上に集まった場合、その場で解雇します。
集める前に飲み物をふるまうと、集まりやすくなります。
水夫が集まったら、[[139|水夫編成]]で艦隊の各船に割り当てます。
records.source_meaning: Town development raises both turnout and costs. Release surplus sailors on the spot. Buying drinks helps recruit, and the assignment command distributes sailors to ships.
records.previous_English:
Recruit Crew (Tavern) 
Recruit sailors for your fleet. Towns 
with higher Growth offer more recruits at 
once, but the fee is higher. Any extra
recruits are dismissed on the spot. Buy a 
round first to improve turnout. Then use
[[139|Assign Sailors]] to place the new recruits
on your ships.
records.heading: Recruit Crew (Tavern)
records.english: Recruit sailors for your fleet. Towns with higher Growth offer more recruits at once, but the fee is higher. Any extra recruits are dismissed on the spot. Buy a round first to improve turnout. Then use [[139|Assign Sailors]] to place the new recruits on your ships.
records.localization_note: Keep the wording and the Assign Sailors link. Set 'Buy a round first' together on the page.

records.source_Japanese:
策謀の立案（酒場）
他の勢力に策略を仕掛けます。
[[118|参謀]]がひらめいたときのみ実行できます。
金貨1000枚が必要です。失敗もあります。
他の勢力がいない海域では、実行できません。「偽文書制作」以外の策略は、他勢力の[[150|シェア]]がある街に行ったことがある場合のみ実行できます。
→[[17|艦隊誘導]]　→[[18|偽文書制作]]　→[[19|悪い噂]]　→[[20|買収]]
records.source_meaning: A strategist's idea permits a scheme for 1,000 gold. Attempts can fail. A rival is required, and all schemes except Forge Papers require a visited town where a rival holds share.
records.previous_English:
Schemes (Tavern)
If your [[118|Strategist]] has an idea, you can 
scheme against a rival. Each attempt
costs 1,000 gold and can fail. You need 
another faction in this region. Except
for Forge Papers, you must have visited a 
town where another faction has
[[150|market share.]] See[[17| Lure Fleet,]]
[[18|Forge Papers,]][[19| Bad Rumors,]] and[[20| Bribe.]]
records.english: Schemes (Tavern) If your [[118|Strategist]] has an idea, you can scheme against a rival. Each attempt costs 1,000 gold and can fail. You need another faction in this region. Except for Forge Papers, you must have visited a town where another faction has [[150|market share.]] See[[17| Lure Fleet,]] [[18|Forge Papers,]][[19| Bad Rumors,]] and[[20| Bribe.]]
records.localization_note: The article matches the Schemes command and keeps its cost, limits and four links.
